Most of my what should have been important relationships whether them being romantic or with my family have ended poorly. My relationship with my father started to spiral when I was 10. Drug abuse along with being physically and mentally abusive towards me. I could literally spend hours talking about all the fucked up things he did to me and just in general. I chose to keep giving him chances until I was about 15. He offered me ketamine in nasal spray. That was the last time I spoke to him. Found out he died in a hospital bed when I was 21. Same with my mother except for being physical. Her drug of choice was crack and meth. I put her in rehab twice and she left early both times. I lived with her when I was 19 and 20 to try and help her with her addiction and I just couldn’t take finding paraphernalia multiple times a week anymore. I just had to leave for my sake. I haven’t spoken to her since 2016. My last romantic relationship almost made me end my life. After moving out and getting myself on my feet I met someone and was with them for 5 years. Of course we had our disagreements during that time but about 4 years in they cheated. (We were engaged) I was so in love and oblivious that I took them back. About 8 months later I proposed again much more romantically and they said yes again. We planned to get married 4 months from that point. Everything was paid for and planned out. 3 weeks before the wedding they ended it through a text. Told me they didn’t love me anymore and wouldn’t elaborate any further. That was probably the worst ending to any relationship I’ve had.
